messages:
kiran: quick heads-up — spotted a privilege escalation in the tenant-sandbox onprem cluster. service account 'sandbox-ctl' has a cluster-admin binding. need immediate RBAC rollback + audit log verification + KMS access scoping. locking this thread to coord.

maya: ack. can you paste the binding? also need to confirm which KMS key the node agent used for metrics encryption. :eyes:

kiran: here's the binding we found (from kube-apiserver audit):
```json
{
  "kind": "ClusterRoleBinding",
  "metadata": { "name": "sandbox-ctl-cluster-admin" },
  "subjects": [{ "kind": "ServiceAccount", "name": "sandbox-ctl", "namespace": "tenant-sandbox" }],
  "roleRef": { "kind": "ClusterRole", "name": "cluster-admin" }
}
```

raj: oncall here. I'll remove the ClusterRoleBinding now and create a scoped role. rolling change to be done with canary to avoid flair. tagging @sam for network policy tweak to stop agent egress to anything except KMS + metrics endpoint.

sam: noted. prepping a NetworkPolicy to lock egress for tenant-sandbox agents. draft below. once RBAC change is applied, I'll patch the node-agent DaemonSet to use the scoped SA.

sam: ```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: sandbox-agent-egress-lock
  namespace: tenant-sandbox
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: node-agent
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress:
  - to:
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 10.0.0.0/24   # internal metrics collector
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          infra: kms
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 443
```

maya: for KMS scoping: we need to rotate the key that the agent used and create a new key with a tighter IAM policy (principals: sandbox-ctl-scoped-sa only, actions: kms:Decrypt, kms:Encrypt). ops-oncall can gate rollout. also enable key usage audit logs to our SIEM.

ops-oncall: will gate. running these steps:
- remove ClusterRoleBinding (kubectl delete clusterrolebinding sandbox-ctl-cluster-admin)
- create Role + RoleBinding in tenant-sandbox with minimal verbs
- patch DaemonSet to use 'sandbox-ctl-scoped-sa'
- apply NetworkPolicy
- rotate KMS key and add IAM binding
- verify audit logs ship to splunk/secure-bucket

sec-bot: Alert: privilege-escalation-detected on cluster tenant-sandbox at 1719009988. Suggested mitigation: revoke cluster-admin binding and rotate node agent creds.

maya: confirm SIEM events for the last 30m show read/write to keys by the node-agent. need to grep audit trail for kms:Decrypt calls from node IPs.

kiran: I pulled the audit entries — there are 3 Decrypt calls from node-07 in the last 18 minutes. logging snippet: 
```
[APIAUDIT] user:system:serviceaccount:tenant-sandbox:sandbox-ctl action:kms:Decrypt key:projects/redwood-kms/cryptoKeys/sandbox-metrics keyVersion:1 srcIP:10.0.7.12
```

raj: taking action now. deleting binding and creating scoped role. will post status.

raj: status update: clusterrolebinding deleted. creating Role 'agent-reader' with minimal perms (get, list on secrets/configmaps) and RoleBinding to sandbox-ctl-scoped-sa. patching DaemonSet to change SA.

kiran: after patch, please verify pod identity and re-run the check for kms:Decrypt. also run `kubectl auth can-i` from the pod to confirm no cluster-admin.

sam: NetworkPolicy applied. validated egress blocked to 0.0.0.0/0 except allowed endpoints.

ops-oncall: KMS key rotation scheduled to start in 10m. will add temporary deny on old key for decrypt while we re-encrypt metrics backlog.

maya: SIEM shows new Decrypt attempts failing after we revoked old key access. good. continue to monitor for any queued replays. enable high-freq audit retention for tenant-sandbox for 48h.

kiran: vulnerability triage notes for postmortem: 
- root cause: overly permissive role binding created by deployment script (deploy-helper v2.1)
- blast radius: tenant-sandbox only; no evidence of data exfiltration yet
- mitigations applied: RBAC rollback, NetworkPolicy, KMS key rotation, audit retention bump
- follow-ups: harden deploy-helper to deny cluster-admin in templates, add pre-apply linter rule, require 2nd approver for onprem cluster-admin changes, document runbook for similar incidents

sam: can we add an admission controller policy to block ClusterRoleBinding creation in onprem clusters except for a small allowlist? I can prototype Gatekeeper rego.

maya: yes please. also add a periodic scan to detect serviceaccounts with high perms and notify security channel.

ops-oncall: once postmortem draft is ready I'll schedule tabletop for response simulation. recommend we run a small drill in staging next week.

kiran: thanks all. last check: any outstanding access we should revoke?

maya: revoke any long-lived tokens issued to sandbox-ctl and remove from vault. rotate any secrets the agent used.

kiran: noted. closing the incident thread after one more verification pass. will open a follow-up for hardening tasks. :lock:
